modelingNotes: Camp North End: 200 Camp Road — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-200-camp-road.ts

A small one-storey depot building of the 1940s–50s at the east end of Camp Road, beside the railway, now retail (Camp North End's "200 Camp Rd, 3,200 sq ft"). A flat-roofed box with a lower flat-roofed wing on its west side.

Evidence: - OSM: way/324612144 (height 5) and its parts way/835850352 (the box, height 5) and way/835850353 (the west wing, min_height 4.9: a roof). - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 0.5 m (measured, NAVD88): ground 226.5 on the west (y = 0), 227.7 on the east; the box's roof 231.7 (5.2 m), flat; the wing 231.2 (4.7 m). - Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903102 (CAMP LANDOWNER LP): one storey, improvements dated 1943–1955, concrete block, face brick and aluminium siding; which is this building's is not recorded. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): the dark grey roof of the box, the plan.

No licensed photo was found (Commons, Openverse, Mapillary). The brick walls are estimated (the parcel lists face brick among its finishes); the windows (one broad panel per bay on the long sides), the end doors and the wing's posts are invented. Built because the lead's list named it; at its size it reads little more than the map's own extrusion.
Frame: the building's own grid; x along bearing 129.2°, y along 39.2°; placement bearing 39.2. The origin is the outline's centroid, lng −80.8310415, lat 35.2473435.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-cne-200-camp-road", model "clt-cne-200-camp-road"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-cne-200-camp-road.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
